_come_si_usa: Una voce per software di job board. Contenuto editoriale scritto a mano e conservativo: native_backfill descrive il backfill nativo in modo onesto (con prezzo solo se pubblico), feed_formats elenca XML/JSON/API solo se documentati. Niente em dash nel copy.

voci.name: Niceboard
voci.native_backfill: Native job backfill is built in and included from the Advanced plan (list price $599/month at the time of writing; the entry Core plan does not include it). The Advanced plan also adds a web scraper and XML import with monthly run limits.
voci.angle: The polished favourite of associations and communities, where backfill lives behind the upper plan.

voci.name: SmartJobBoard
voci.native_backfill: Built-in backfill through aggregator plugins (ZipRecruiter, Jobs2Careers): network jobs render below your native listings, are not stored in your database, redirect to the source on click, and pay you a revenue share. Only one backfill plugin can be active at a time. XML feed importers and an API are available on the platform.
voci.angle: A 2008 veteran where backfill is a revenue-share plugin, not your own dataset.

voci.name: JBoard
voci.native_backfill: Built-in backfill via Adzuna and Indeed integrations is available on paid plans, alongside a web page scraper that reads employer pages with Google Jobs structured data. XML/JSON import and API access sit on higher tiers.
voci.angle: The no-code board builder with aggregator backfill on tap from the entry plans.

voci.name: JobBoard.io
voci.native_backfill: No native backfill is documented publicly. The platform targets media companies and enterprises, and data imports are handled case by case through its professional services rather than a self-serve backfill switch.
voci.angle: The enterprise publisher's board: strong on sales workflow, quiet on self-serve backfill.

voci.name: Jobiqo
voci.native_backfill: No public documentation of a native backfill feature. Jobiqo builds boards on a Drupal-based platform with XML feed imports as the standard intake route; anything richer is a project conversation.
voci.angle: The Austrian Drupal shop behind several European public and niche boards.

voci.name: WP Job Manager
voci.native_backfill: No built-in backfill: the official Indeed backfill plugin was retired in 2023. The practical route is WP All Import, which loads XML or JSON feeds into listings, or community add-ons. Your board is WordPress, so anything importable can become a listing.
voci.angle: The WordPress standard: no native backfill, but the whole plugin ecosystem is your import layer.

voci.name: Job Boardly
voci.native_backfill: A native Job Backfiller with a pool of over 7 million jobs is built in, billed as usage-based backfill credits (public comparisons quote about $9 per 1,000 credits) on top of the subscription.
voci.angle: The budget board builder whose backfill is a metered add-on, not a data plan.

voci.name: eJobSiteSoftware
voci.native_backfill: No native backfill network is documented. The platform documents XML feed imports as its intake route, with guides for mapping external feeds into its schema.
voci.angle: A long-running hosted board platform where XML feeds do the heavy lifting.

voci.name: JobBoard.com
voci.native_backfill: No public documentation of a native backfill feature that we could verify. Treat imports as a conversation with the vendor.
voci.angle: A legacy hosted board brand; verify the import story before you sign.

voci.name: JobBoardHQ
voci.native_backfill: No public documentation of a native backfill feature that we could verify. As with most association-oriented platforms, XML feed import is the route to ask about.
voci.angle: Association career centers, conservative on public technical docs.

voci.name: JobMount
voci.native_backfill: No public documentation of a native backfill feature that we could verify. The platform is aimed at publishers and associations; expect XML feed imports rather than a built-in job pool.
voci.angle: Publisher-grade board software with an enterprise sales motion.

voci.name: Talenetic
voci.native_backfill: No public documentation of a native backfill feature that we could verify. Talenetic builds boards for publishers and recruitment groups; imports are handled as part of the setup.
voci.angle: UK board platform for media groups, low public technical detail.

voci.name: JobThread
voci.native_backfill: JobThread Publisher is itself a network: your board shows network jobs next to your own and you earn a revenue share on them, on a free plan that takes a share of employer fees. Backfill is the business model, not a feature tier.
voci.angle: The network-as-backfill model: free software, shared jobs, shared revenue.

voci.name: Artha Job Board
voci.native_backfill: No public documentation of a native backfill feature that we could verify. A newer AI-positioned board builder; confirm the import and backfill story in the demo.
voci.angle: A newer AI-flavoured entrant in the board software market.
